steps.name: review-project-state
steps.description: Aggregate project state (tasks, suggestions, costs); read t0094 + recent task results; reassess high-priority suggestions independently; present state to researcher.

steps.name: discuss-decisions
steps.description: Researcher proposed broadening the MOBO objective space (DSI x ITR, DSI x energy, DSI x cytoplasm volume) and asked for an extensive literature search; 3 multi-choice clarifications resolved scope (broad / consolidated / catalogue + formulas + recipes); confirmation arrived as 'fire away'.

steps.name: apply-decisions
steps.description: Create t0096 via /create-task with the consolidated literature-survey scope; write 2 suggestion-rejection correction files (S-0093-01, S-0074-03).

steps.name: finalize
steps.description: Write results, step logs, session capture, run verificators, materialiser, PR, premerge, merge.
